Tom Carter and Gosney (Eastleigh) soon sorted themselves out, followed by George Hoath and took the field along at a rare pace and these places were maintained to the finish, although Tom made a game effort.

The end of the first lap saw Gosney, Hughes and Bunton running together in a bunch, with our "evergreen" Tom Carter in close attendance. Behind Tom came Reid, of Birchfield and Scottish International, to be followed by Cole, of Dudley, the Junior International.

Eric Herbert ran an excellent race to finish third to Gosney and Barry in the Civil Service C.C.
Gosney of Eastleigh beat Olney the local "crack" in the individual race, but our lads packed well with Tom Clinton 4th, Dick Towndrow 5th, Ted Stimpson 6th and Frank Abberton 7th.
